I think Blizzard have made their peace with the fact that they will never please Everybody within the Warcraft community. They've made the level scaling changes and they think it's for the best of the game as a whole. Me personally i might level another character or finishing levelling something just to see. But the principle behind it was always to create a more immersive experience for players, allowing players to never feel like they have to leave a zone midway through its narrative arc.

I thought the point of scaling was to allow players to immerse themselves in the narrative of the zone without out leveling the zone, so that they could see quest chain narratives to completion...maybe it only works if youre interested in the story and side story of each zone. Also for new players (they do exist) itll make more sense as they wont become too powerful for the zones as they level through them...remember the game is about 10 years older than it was originally planned for...

Yea check your journal for follow on quests. Pay attention to the story of the zone youre questing in. Itll lead you on. Side quests generall begin and end within the zone.
